scopeRules.general: Applies to all Palmon in the same squad.
scopeRules.element: Applies only to Palmon of the specified element in the same squad.
scopeRules.conditional: Battle effect with its own condition; not treated as a simple always-on squad stat.

skillRules.unlock: Skill 1 unlocks at 1 star, Skill 2 at 2 stars, and so on.
skillRules.toolBehavior: Unlocked skills may be upgraded freely in the calculator. The ingame random skill-upgrade selection is intentionally not simulated.
skillRules.effectBehavior: Only the effect of the currently selected skill level applies; skill level effects are not cumulative.

ascensionRules.otherEffectStacking: Element Attack/Defense/HP replace previous values. Counter bonuses, repeated Crit Rate and repeated Tenacity effects stack additively.
